text_markup: The symbol [interrupt] (plaintext: {curly:interrupt}) stands for "interrupt timing". It is used to designate abilities that resolve immediately before other abilities. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements} for rules about interrupt abilities.
text_plain: The symbol {interrupt} (plaintext: {interrupt}) stands for "interrupt timing". It is used to designate abilities that resolve immediately before other abilities. See section 9.9 for rules about interrupt abilities.
